transitions.fromZh: 无耳深窖：蜡笔大耳朵线索未读
transitions.toZh: 触读蜡笔大耳朵刻痕，记下「听」字与最后一卷蜡封
transitions.toEn: Read the Wax-Deaf mark and record the character “hear” and the last wax seal
transitions.narrativeZh: 封耳匣只剩的灰蜡封不再只是余数；有人把「听」留在了刻痕旁。
transitions.narrativeEn: The last grey seal is no longer merely a remainder; someone has left “hear” beside the mark.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 深窖仍听着；没有人替那只失去的耳朵补名。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The Deeps keep listening; no one names the missing ear.

transitions.fromZh: 无耳深窖：封耳匣刻痕已读，灰蜡封尚未归档
transitions.fromEn: Earless Deeps: Satchel of Seals mark read, grey seal not yet filed
transitions.toZh: 将最后一只灰蜡封登记为已见，不宣称它已被认领
transitions.toEn: Record the last grey seal as witnessed without claiming it
transitions.narrativeZh: 最后一只灰蜡封有了见证记录；它仍留在匣旁，不被拿走。
transitions.narrativeEn: The last grey seal gains a witness entry; it remains beside the satchel, untouched.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 万籁只听见一次屏息，没有把它当作脚步。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The Myriad hears one held breath and does not mistake it for a footstep.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 封耳匣旁，最后一只灰蜡封仍在。
transitions.atlasHookEn: The last grey seal remains beside the satchel.

transitions.fromZh: 低音之城：账册只记债额
transitions.fromEn: Bass Citadel: the ledger records debts only
transitions.toZh: 石喉母亲开启「听账」栏，记录来者坐下与倾听的时长
transitions.toEn: The Stone-Throat Matriarch opens a listening-debt column to record who sits and for how long
transitions.narrativeZh: 新栏不计欠了多少，只记谁来坐一坐、听多久；账本因此不再那么厚。
transitions.narrativeEn: The new column records who sits and listens, not what they owe; the ledger grows less thick.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 石喉母亲合上账本，向来者点头，不问缘由。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The Matriarch closes the ledger and nods, without asking why.
transitions.atlasHookEn: At the ledger’s end: listening debt.

transitions.fromZh: 风钟海岸：盐结小龛尚未记录
transitions.fromEn: Windbell Coast: Salt Shrine not yet recorded
transitions.toZh: 见证岬角盐龛经潮水抹去又重写，将其记入游记
transitions.toEn: Witness the tide erase and rewrite the headland’s salt shrine, then enter it in the Atlas
transitions.narrativeZh: 盐龛仍会被海抹去、重写；记录留下见证，不把每日变化定成终局。
transitions.narrativeEn: The sea still erases and rewrites the shrine; the entry bears witness without fixing its daily change as an ending.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 海潮照常往复，没有替刻痕作答。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The tide continues; it does not answer on the mark’s behalf.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 岬角盐龛：潮抹去，也重写。
transitions.atlasHookEn: Headland salt shrine: erased, rewritten by the tide.

atlasDraft.pZh: 傍晚，钟摆停在最低处。阿汐没有数盐，也没有翻开薄簿。摆旁的空位仍无人坐。薄簿合着，页角轻轻抬起，又落回原处。有些页，合着也在。
atlasDraft.pEn: At dusk, the pendulum rested at its lowest point. Axi did not count the salt or open the thin ledger. The place beside the pendulum remained empty. The ledger stayed shut; its corner lifted slightly, then settled. Some pages remain, even closed.
